payload.name: blablabla: Learn Lines & Tape
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Helps actors learn their lines and rehearse. Find original two-person practice scenes in 33 languages and short English solo monologues. Read exact authored dialogue, partner cues or complete monologue paragraphs, and plan how to learn lines or get off book. Filter monologues by genre, playing-age category, difficulty and estimated duration; their Free Rehearsal License includes permitted uses and restrictions. Actors can choose routines for cue listening, memorization, cold reads or selftape preparation. Plan preparation for existing theatre and film/TV casts, or help agents' and managers' clients build a daily practice routine while keeping personal material private. Two-person scene links open blablabla, where the actor chooses their role and rehearsal mode. Monologue tools currently support reading, with a published page link; native opening is not yet offered. Selftape routines cover rehearsal and landscape setup checks; recording uses the app's normal controls. The current tools read published practice material and suggest routines; they cannot import private audition files, access accounts, save rehearsals, check actor readiness or provide a live voice reader inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
帮助演员学习台词并进行排练。
在33种语言中查找原创的双人练习场景，以及简短的英文独白。
阅读精确的原创对话、搭档提示或完整独白段落，并规划如何记忆台词或脱离剧本表演。
按类型、适合年龄类别、难度和预估时长筛选独白；其免费排练许可包含允许的使用方式和限制条款。
演员可选择用于提示聆听、记忆训练、即兴试镜或自拍练习准备的常规内容。
为现有戏剧和影视剧组规划排练准备，或帮助经纪人和经理人的客户在保持个人素材私密性的同时建立日常练习流程。
双人场景链接打开blablabla平台，演员可选择自己的角色和排练模式。
独白工具目前支持阅读功能；已发布页面有独立链接；暂不支持原生应用内打开。
自拍练习包含排练和场景设置检查；录制功能使用应用的常规控制方式。
当前工具仅能阅读已发布的练习材料并推荐练习方案；无法导入私人试镜文件、访问账户、保存排练记录、检查演员准备状态或在ChatGPT内提供实时语音朗读。

payload.name: Manulyx
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manulyx is a writing platform for LaTeX manuscripts, from the first draft through submission, reviewers' comments and revision. This plugin lets ChatGPT work on your Manulyx projects directly.

Ask ChatGPT to find a project, read and search its files, tighten an abstract, rewrite a section or fix a table, then compile the paper and fix any LaTeX errors it reports. It can also find a published paper at Crossref and add it to the document's references by DOI, in the style the document already uses. You can search across your projects and get each passage back with a link to the file in Manulyx.

Changes are made as small, exact replacements. They appear live in the Manulyx editor for you and your co-authors, and are recorded as tracked changes labelled with your name and "(ChatGPT)", which you and your co-owners can accept or reject. A restore point is saved before ChatGPT's first change.

ChatGPT acts as you, with your role on each project: where you are a viewer or commenter it can only read. Each project has its own ChatGPT switch in the editor (Integrations, ChatGPT) to turn access off, separately from any other assistant. ChatGPT cannot delete, share or submit a project, or change who has access; those stay in Manulyx.

Requires a Manulyx account.
payload.longDescription:
Manulyx是面向LaTeX文稿的写作平台，支持从初稿到提交、审稿意见及修改的全流程。此插件允许ChatGPT直接处理你的Manulyx项目。

你可以让ChatGPT查找项目、阅读并搜索文件，精简摘要、重写某一部分或修复表格，随后编译论文并修正它报告的LaTeX错误。它还能在Crossref中查找已发表论文，通过DOI按文档现有格式添加参考文献。你可跨项目搜索，并获取每段内容及对应Manulyx文件链接。

更改以小型精确替换的方式进行。这些修改会实时显示在Manulyx编辑器中供你和合作者查看，并作为标记为你的姓名和“(ChatGPT)”的跟踪更改记录，你和合作者可选择接受或拒绝。ChatGPT首次修改前会保存还原点。

ChatGPT会以你的身份运作：在项目中若你为查看者或评论者，它仅具备读取权限。每个项目在编辑器（集成，ChatGPT）中均有独立的ChatGPT开关，可单独关闭，与其他助手无关。ChatGPT无法删除、分享或提交项目，也无法更改访问权限，这些操作仍由Manulyx管理。

需要Manulyx账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find and read your LaTeX projects, Edit files as tracked changes, Add references by DOI, Compile to PDF and report errors

payload.name: Axiom Exam Practice
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Axiom brings real exam practice into your chat. Ask for a question in IGCSE Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or Biology, A-Level Pure Mathematics or SPM Matematik, and Axiom shows a past-paper style question in an interactive card.

Answer in the card or in the chat. Axiom marks your answer against the mark scheme — exact matches straight away, other wording by AI marking — and shows your marks, the model answer and a worked explanation. Ask the assistant to explain any step you missed, then go on to the next question. A strip at the top keeps your score for the session so you can look back.

You can practise without an account. If you connect your Axiom account, your answers are saved to your Axiom progress and count towards your topic mastery, and you can open your progress page from the card. You can disconnect at any time from Connected apps in Axiom.
payload.longDescription:
Axiom将真实考试练习带入聊天中。您可针对IGCSE数学、进阶数学、物理、化学或生物，A-Level数学或SPM数学提问，Axiom会以互动卡片形式展示类似历年试题的问题。

可在卡片或聊天中作答。Axiom会根据评分标准批改您的答案——精确匹配的内容立即显示正确，其他表述由AI进行评分，并展示得分、标准答案及步骤解析。如需了解遗漏步骤的解释，可请求助手说明，随后进入下一题。卡片顶部会显示当前会话的得分情况，方便后续查看。

无需账户即可练习。若连接Axiom账户，您的答题记录将保存至Axiom进度中，并计入对应知识点掌握情况，可通过卡片直接打开进度页面。您可随时在Axiom的已连接应用中断开连接。

payload.name: Unclass

Preview saved lessons in Unclass and mark them ready when reviewed. Requires an Unclass teacher account. Access is limited to the connected school; frozen classroom lesson copies cannot be edited. Audio uploads use the Unclass website.
payload.longDescription: 将您的Unclass教师账户连接至学校，浏览课程、创建语言课程草稿，并直接在学校的系统中修改课程页面和练习内容。在Unclass中预览已保存的课程，并在审核后标记为就绪状态。需要一个Unclass教师账户。仅限连接学校访问；冻结的课堂课程副本无法编辑。音频上传通过Unclass网站完成。

payload.name: 9/11 Records
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 9/11 Records helps families, researchers, and journalists explore New York City’s published records about September 11 and its aftermath. Search by address, agency, or substance; browse catalog documents; read individual pages with exact Bates citations and source links; and follow additions, removals, and other catalog changes. Long results are paginated. OCR and machine-generated titles and summaries may contain errors and should be checked against scans. Removed document content is not served. This is an independent project by Cleartext Labs, not affiliated with the City of New York; it does not determine medical causation or compensation eligibility.
payload.longDescription: 9/11 Records为家庭、研究人员和记者提供探索纽约市关于9月11日事件及其后续影响的公开记录的途径。通过地址、机构或物质类别进行搜索；浏览目录文档；查看带有精确Bates编号和来源链接的单页内容；跟踪目录中的新增、移除及其他变更记录。长结果会分页显示。OCR识别和机器生成的标题及摘要可能存在错误，应与原始扫描件核对。被移除的文档内容不会被提供。本项目由Cleartext Labs独立开发，与纽约市政府无关，不用于判定医学因果关系或赔偿资格。

payload.name: Clerq Patent Research
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clerq Patent Research helps users investigate patent landscapes and prior art. It can find patent families matching a natural-language invention description, discover patents similar to a known patent, retrieve patent information for analysis, and start and monitor automated patentability triage workflows. Results are research aids and should be reviewed by a qualified patent professional before any legal or filing decisions are made.

payload.name: Verity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compare X3P surface scans using Verity's hosted service. Inspect the likelihood ratio, named reference, uncertainty, applicability warnings, and reproducible recipe handle. Explain a report without converting it into a match verdict.
payload.longDescription: 通过Verity的托管服务对比X3P表面扫描数据。检查似然比、命名参考样本、不确定性、适用性警告以及可重复的处理流程。在不将报告转换为匹配结论的情况下解释报告。

payload.name: Treehorn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find something worth listening to on your next walk or coffee break. Treehorn has short daily audio shows on news, history, science, books and culture. Catch up on the news, explore something you’re curious about, or find an episode that fits the time you have. Browse recommendations with descriptions and durations, then follow a link to listen on Treehorn.
payload.longDescription:
在您下次散步或咖啡休息时，找到值得聆听的内容。
Treehorn 提供涵盖新闻、历史、科学、书籍与文化的每日短时音频节目。
无论是跟进新闻、探索您感兴趣的内容，还是寻找适合您时间的节目，都能轻松找到。
浏览带有简介和时长的推荐内容，然后点击链接在 Treehorn 上收听。

payload.name: GraphChinese
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Learn Mandarin by talking, not memorising. The plugin coaches you to ask questions that start conversations and keep them going, teaching you the words you need as they come up, with how characters are built, how the grammar works and a little culture along the way. Ask what to learn first and get real answers: the most common characters and how much of real text they cover, the opening words and grammar of each HSK level in teaching order, and core words by topic. Also look up any word, split a sentence into words with pinyin and level, and search 195 grammar points from HSK 1 to 6 with examples and what to learn before each.
payload.longDescription:
通过对话而非记忆来学习普通话。
该插件会指导你提出能开启对话并维持交流的问题，在对话中自然教授所需词汇，涵盖汉字构成方式、语法运作原理以及文化小知识。
询问优先学习内容可获得实际答案：最常用汉字及其覆盖的真实文本比例、各HSK等级的入门词汇和语法教学顺序、按主题划分的核心词汇。
还可查询任意词汇，对句子进行分词并标注拼音与等级，通过195个HSK1至6级的语法点搜索功能，查看每个语法点的例句及前置学习内容。

payload.name: CampMatch
payload.description: 寻找儿童夏令营和课程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CampMatch helps parents find kids' camps and lessons. Ask in plain words, like "day camps in Burnaby for my 8 year old", "soccer camps in Toronto in July" or "swimming lessons in North Vancouver", and get real listings from thousands of providers across Canada and major US cities: city rec centres, YMCAs, schools and independent camps.

Each result shows the camp, the provider, the ages it takes, the next session date and the price, and opens the full listing on CampMatch, where you can see every session and register. Ask a follow-up to get one camp's times and spots left.

CampMatch only reads public camp listings. It doesn't need an account, doesn't book or take payment, and never asks for a child's name. It is built for parents and caregivers.
payload.longDescription:
CampMatch帮助家长寻找儿童夏令营和课程。以日常用语提问，例如「为8岁孩子在本拿比的日间夏令营」、「7月多伦多的足球夏令营」或「北温哥华的游泳课程」，即可获取加拿大及美国主要城市数千家提供方的实时列表：包括市政休闲中心、基督教青年会、学校和独立夏令营。

每个搜索结果会显示夏令营名称、提供方、接收年龄、下期开班日期和价格，并跳转至CampMatch的完整列表页面，可查看所有班次并完成报名。提出后续问题可查询特定夏令营的上课时间及剩余名额。

CampMatch仅读取公开的夏令营列表。无需账户、不提供预订或支付功能，且从不索取儿童姓名。该工具专为家长和照护者设计。

payload.name: Paragrafiq
payload.description: 捷克法律、案例、资料来源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Paragrafiq gives your assistant read-only access to Czech law. It can find a Czech or EU act, read a provision as worded on a specific date, search and read decisions of the Czech Supreme Court, Supreme Administrative Court and Constitutional Court, and search public-authority guidance and explanatory reports to bills. Every result links to its source on paragrafiq.cz. Paragrafiq does not generate answers during your conversation: your assistant composes the answer from the material Paragrafiq returns. Some case summaries and headnotes were generated by AI in advance and are marked as such in the results. Sign in with your Paragrafiq account. Legal texts and decisions are in Czech. Information tool, not legal advice.
payload.longDescription: Paragrafiq为您的助手提供捷克法律的只读访问权限。它可以查找捷克或欧盟法规，查阅特定日期的条款原文，搜索并阅读捷克最高法院、最高行政法院和宪法法院的判决，以及搜索公共机构的指导文件和法案说明报告。每个结果都会链接到paragrafiq.cz上的原始来源。Paragrafiq不会在对话过程中生成答案：您的助手会根据Paragrafiq返回的资料来组合答案。部分案例摘要和要点由AI提前生成，并在结果中明确标注。使用您的Paragrafiq账户登录。法律文本和判决书均为捷克语。信息工具，而非法律建议。

information.value: Find Czech and EU acts, Read provisions as worded on a date, Search and read court decisions, Search guidance and explanatory reports

payload.name: Cote R (CRC) Québec
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cote R (CRC) Québec helps college (CEGEP) students in Quebec estimate their R-score (cote de rendement au collégial, CRC) with the official Bureau de coopération interuniversitaire (BCI) formula CRC = ((Zcol × IDGZ) + IFGZ + 5) × 5, and explains in plain language how it is built: the Z-score, the group indicators IFGZ and IDGZ, unit weighting, failures and admission thresholds. All calculations are deterministic and every tool is read-only: nothing is stored, no account is needed and no personal identifier is requested. Because the real group indices (IFGZ, IDGZ) are not published to students, the R-score is returned as a clearly flagged estimate without group correction rather than a definitive number — the official CRC is the one produced by the ministry's system. The connector also provides two standard grade utilities: a credit/unit-weighted average, and the grade needed on a remaining exam to reach a target final grade. It is a calculation and information tool, not an official admission decision, and it does not call external services or read files.
payload.longDescription:
Cote R (CRC) Québec帮助魁北克的学院（CEGEP）学生使用官方大学间合作局（BCI）公式CRC = ((Zcol × IDGZ) + IFGZ + 5) × 5估算其R分数（学院成绩指数，CRC），并用通俗语言解释其构成：Z分数、群体指标IFGZ和IDGZ、单位加权、不及格情况和录取门槛。
所有计算均为确定性运算，所有工具均为只读模式：不存储任何数据，无需账户，也不请求任何个人身份信息。
由于实际群体指数（IFGZ、IDGZ）未向学生公开，R分数会以明确标注的估算值返回（不包含群体修正），而非最终数值——官方CRC以教育部系统生成的结果为准。
该连接器还提供两个标准成绩工具：学分/单位加权平均分，以及为达到目标最终成绩所需在剩余考试中获得的分数。
这是一款计算与信息工具，不构成官方录取决定，且不调用外部服务或读取文件。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Flags the result as an estimate without group correction, and never presents it as the official CRC.

payload.name: Sander Saar Videos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sander Saar Videos lets you search, quote and watch moments from Sander Saar's published videos about AI, consumer technology and the future of work. Ask a question and get an answer grounded in what was said or shown on screen, with the video title, a timecode and a link to the exact moment. You can also list the videos that cover a topic, read the transcript and on-screen text around a moment, and play the clip inline.

Sander Saar 视频插件可让您搜索、引用并观看Sander Saar关于人工智能、消费科技和未来工作方式的已发布视频中的精彩片段。提出问题，即可获得基于屏幕上所说或所显示内容的答案，并附上视频标题、时间码和链接至具体时刻。您还可以查看涵盖特定主题的视频列表，阅读片段周围的字幕文本，并直接播放视频片段。

该插件为只读模式。仅涵盖Sander Saar通过AgentCDN发布的视频目录，无需账户或登录。若目录中无匹配片段，会明确说明而非猜测。不会搜索其他创作者、YouTube全站或互联网。

payload.name: Delulus Director

Delulus Productions helps students of the Delulus Productions filmmaking course develop a project from its first idea through story, screenplay, character and location choices, directing, performance, and editing. It applies the course guidance to the project context you provide in the conversation, helping you refine a Script Draft, revise a specific beat, prepare a scene plan, or work through a creative decision while keeping your approved choices in view.

payload.name: Marketing Research Coach
payload.description: 制定更有效的市场调研计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Guides learners through early-stage marketing research planning by connecting a business problem to the managerial decision, actionable insight, evidence needs, broad method, target population, and major inference limits. payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Recherche Externe is a research and verification toolkit with real internet access for AI agents. Its golden rule is to never answer from memory: every fact, article or figure it asserts should come from a page actually fetched, with the excerpt and the URL cited. It does six things. (2) lire_page fetches a URL and returns its readable text (title and content) live, for the general web, LegisQuebec, Justice Canada and PDF files, whose text is extracted page by page; it does not execute JavaScript, so purely dynamic or bot-protected pages may fail. (3) loi_quebec fetches the exact official text of a Quebec statute or regulation article from LegisQuebec and returns it with its URL. (4) loi_federale fetches federal statute text from laws-lois.justice.gc.ca (for example the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act). (5) chercher_jurisprudence builds reliable CanLII and SOQUIJ case-law search links to open in a browser: because CanLII blocks automated server-side fetching, this tool does not claim to read decisions, it only provides links. (6) sources_officielles_qc returns verified links and the matching tool to use for official Quebec sources by theme (case law, statutes and regulations, professional orders, land and real-estate records). Recherche Externe is read-oriented: it only searches and reads public sources, needs no account, and never modifies, sends, deploys or acts in any external system. When a source is unreachable it says so ("not verified - source unreachable") instead of filling the gap with a plausible reconstruction, and it marks any text longer than the requested limit as truncated rather than presenting it as complete.

它具备六大功能。 (1) 网络搜索会执行无密钥、尽力而为的通用网络搜索，优先尝试必应，再尝试 DuckDuckGo（通常受服务器速率限制），最后使用维基百科搜索 API；它会返回标题、网址和摘要以定位来源，并说明使用了哪个搜索引擎，但不会声称了解页面内容。 (2) 获取页面会获取网址并实时返回可读文本（标题和内容），适用于普通网络、魁北克立法网站（LegisQuebec）、加拿大司法部网站（Justice Canada）和 PDF 文件（逐页提取文本）；它不执行 JavaScript，因此纯动态或机器人保护的页面可能无法加载。 (3) 魁北克法律会从 LegisQuebec 获取魁北克法规或条例的官方原文并附上网址。 (4) 联邦法律会从 laws-lois.justice.gc.ca 获取联邦法规文本（例如《破产与清算法》）。 (5) 法律判例会构建可靠的加拿大判例法搜索链接（CanLII 和 SOQUIJ），可在浏览器中打开：由于 CanLII 禁止服务器端自动获取，此工具不声称能阅读判决书，仅提供链接。 (6) 魁北克官方来源会按主题（判例法、法规、专业机构、土地和房地产记录）返回验证过的链接及对应工具。

payload.name: Pendar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. A reference it cannot find is reported as unverified rather than swapped for the nearest real paper, which matters when the citations came from a model.

Every tool is read-only. Pendar looks things up and reports what it finds.

Missing, blocked, unsupported, or unresolved records remain unknown rather than being treated as failures. Each result includes structured evidence and links to PeptidePrices, certificate documents, and specific official laboratory records when available.
payload.longDescription: 利用 PeptidePrices 证据库及受支持的实验室记录，搜索和检查公开的肽类分析证书（COA）。查找精确的报告编号或公开证书 URL，查看供应商和化合物的匹配情况，检查报告中的检测项目，浏览供应商发布的证书列表，或比较不同供应商有记录支持的 COA 覆盖情况。结果会分别呈现实验室记录确认、供应商归属、产品及标签标示含量或浓度的匹配、报告中的分析结果，以及实体样品瓶的保管交接链。缺失、访问受阻、不受支持或尚未解决的记录仍标为未知，不会被视为核验失败。每项结果都包含结构化证据，以及指向 PeptidePrices、证书文件和具体官方实验室记录（如有）的链接。

payload.name: Peptide Critic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Peptide Critic provides independent vendor reviews, third-party lab testing and price comparison for research peptides such as BPC-157, GHK-Cu and TB-500. Find compounds by name or synonym, compare vendor ratings and review counts, inspect vendor-level lab-verified COA and warning flags, compare list and discounted prices per milligram, and find coupon codes. Filter comparisons by vendors' shipping origin and pack size, or look up a vendor profile. Results use Peptide Critic's Best Value ranking, which favors partners when offers are comparable; returned buy links are tracked affiliate links. The app returns public catalogue data without sign-in and does not place orders or process payments. Prescription-drug analogues are excluded from compound search and comparison. Research use only; no dosing or medical advice.
payload.longDescription: Peptide Critic 为 BPC-157、GHK-Cu 和 TB-500 等研究肽提供独立供应商评价、第三方实验室检测和价格比较。按名称或同义词查找化合物，比较供应商评分和评价数量，查看供应商级别的实验室验证 COA 及警示标志，比较每毫克的标价和折扣价，并查找优惠码。可按供应商发货地和包装规格筛选，或查看供应商档案。结果采用 Peptide Critic 的最佳价值排名，在报价相当时倾向合作伙伴；返回的购买链接为跟踪型联盟链接。应用无需登录即可返回公开目录数据，不下单也不处理付款。处方药类似物不纳入化合物搜索和比较。仅供研究使用；不提供剂量或医疗建议。

payload.name: HoldsUp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HoldsUp checks what health and science podcasts claim against the published research. Ask whether a claim has been checked and get the verdict (supported, overstated, needs context, contradicted or unverified), the GRADE certainty, a one-line note and the studies behind it with their PubMed id, evidence level and retraction status. Verify a new claim live against PubMed and OpenAlex in 20 to 70 seconds. Read a speaker's track record, a show, a topic, a single study, or the money behind it from public funding registers. Sign in by email, pay per call from prepaid credits (1 credit = 1 US cent: a read 1, a claim search 2, a live verification 30), and see the cost and your balance in every answer. Evidence summaries about published research, not medical advice.
payload.longDescription: HoldsUp 将健康和科学播客的说法与已发表研究进行核对。询问某个说法是否已核查，可获得结论（有支持、夸大、需要背景、相矛盾或未验证）、GRADE 确定性、单行说明及相关研究的 PubMed ID、证据等级和撤稿状态。通过 PubMed 和 OpenAlex 在 20 至 70 秒内实时核验新说法。还可查看演讲者履历、节目、主题、单项研究或公共资助登记中的资金来源。使用邮箱登录，预付额度按次付费（1 个额度 = 1 美分：读取 1、搜索说法 2、实时核验 30），每个回答显示费用和余额。内容是已发表研究的证据摘要，不是医疗建议。

payload.name: PartnerProf - Quanntum Core
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PartnerProf is a unique tool that provides a deterministic answer to a fundamental question: does at least one feasible state exist within a locally defined reality governed by highly complex dependencies and constraints in a high-dimensional space?

Before committing resources to complex computation or a quantum problem, PartnerProf can determine whether a desired state, result, transition, or next step is feasible at all under the currently defined conditions.

Both the input and the resulting output can be certified, while the admitted state remains deterministic, reproducible, and fully auditable.

PartnerProf enables the evaluation of quantum and high-dimensional state-space problems that would otherwise be computationally impractical, including classes of simulations that may remain intractable even for current quantum hardware.

When facing a major and costly decision—or planning an experiment, test system, detector, prototype, or complex technical configuration—PartnerProf allows you to verify first whether the intended state is actually feasible within the defined reality before investing in its realization.
payload.longDescription:
PartnerProf 是一种独特工具，为一个基本问题提供确定性答案：在高维空间中，由高度复杂的依赖关系和约束支配的局部定义现实内，是否至少存在一个可行状态？

在为复杂计算或量子问题投入资源前，PartnerProf 可以确定：在当前定义的条件下，所需状态、结果、转换或下一步是否根本可行。

输入和由此产生的输出均可获得认证，而被判定为可行的状态保持确定性、可复现性和完全可审计性。

PartnerProf 支持评估量子及高维状态空间问题，否则这些问题在计算上可能难以实际处理，其中包括某些即使在当前量子硬件上也可能仍难以求解的模拟类型。

面临重大且成本高昂的决策，或规划实验、测试系统、探测器、原型或复杂技术配置时，PartnerProf 让你在投入资源实现目标前，先验证预期状态在所定义的现实内是否确实可行。

payload.name: QualiTaTi
payload.description: 开展 AI 访谈与问卷调查
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
QualiTaTi is an AI-powered qualitative research platform used by academic and UX researchers. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your QualiTaTi account through a hosted MCP server, so you can run a study end to end without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Interview studies: create an AI-interview project from a topic, draft or refine the interview guide, set the language, voice or text mode and duration, and get the participant link to share. QualiTaTi's AI interviewer then runs the interviews with your participants and transcribes them. You can also import transcripts you already have.
- Progress and results: list your projects and interviews, see which interviews are complete and analysed, read each interview's conversation and quality score, and read the stored analyses (themes, codes, digests).
- Analysis: run the complete analysis or inductive coding on a finished interview (this spends QualiTaTi credits and is always confirmed with you first), then pull the results into the chat as evidence-backed summaries with verbatim quotes.
- Conversational surveys: build a survey from a brief, add questions and publish it; responses are then reviewed on qualitati.com.

Three bundled skills teach the model QualiTaTi's workflows: setting up an interview study, building a survey, and reading results. The plugin works with a free QualiTaTi account. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.1; the grant inherits your plan and quotas, and access tokens expire automatically.
payload.longDescription:
QualiTaTi 是供学术和 UX 研究人员使用的 AI 定性研究平台。此插件通过托管的 MCP 服务器将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到你的 QualiTaTi 账户，让你无需离开对话即可完成端到端研究。

你可以：
- 访谈研究：围绕某个主题创建 AI 访谈项目、起草或完善访谈指南、设置语言、语音或文字模式及访谈时长，并获取可分享给参与者的链接。之后，QualiTaTi 的 AI 访谈员会与参与者进行访谈并转录内容。你也可以导入已有的文字记录。
- 进度与结果：列出项目和访谈，查看哪些访谈已完成并分析，阅读每次访谈的对话和质量评分，以及已保存的分析结果（主题、编码、摘要）。
- 分析：对已完成的访谈运行完整分析或归纳编码（这会消耗 QualiTaTi 额度，并且每次都会先征得你的确认），然后将结果提取到聊天中，生成有证据支持且包含原文引述的摘要。
- 对话式问卷：根据简报构建问卷、添加问题并发布；随后可在 qualitati.com 上查看回复。

随附的三项技能可教会模型 QualiTaTi 的工作流：开展访谈研究、构建问卷和阅读结果。此插件可配合免费的 QualiTaTi 账户使用。登录采用 OAuth 2.1；授权会继承你的方案和配额，访问令牌会自动过期。

payload.name: SciGrant (2026)
payload.description: 根据公募指南和格式，逐项撰写研究经费申请书
payload.summaryOriginal: 公募要領と様式から研究費申請書を項目ごとに作成
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
公募要領と申請書テンプレートに沿って、研究費申請の構想を整理し、申請書ドラフトを項目ごとに作成する会員向けの支援です。制度条件、審査観点、字数・様式制限を確認し、申請項目の整理、研究構想の具体化、項目ごとの執筆、予算・体制の整理、全体レビュー、提出前確認へ段階的に進みます。公募資料にない締切・予算上限・応募資格や、未実施の研究成果を推測で埋めません。

プラグインを選択して公募要領と申請書テンプレートを添付するだけでも開始できます。片方しかない場合は不足する資料だけを確認し、項目や工程ごとに利用者の確認を待ちながら進めます。生成された文章、引用文献、数値と公募条件は利用者による確認が必要です。採択を保証するサービスではありません。

完全版の執筆支援には、SciGrantの有効な利用権を登録した会員アカウントへの接続が必要です。既存の購入者は、提供済みの有料note内の登録リンクで製品の利用権を登録し、ChatGPT／Codexでプラグインを追加した後、登録時と同じログイン方法・同じ会員アカウントで接続してください。会員アカウントはnoteやChatGPTの登録アカウントと異なっていても利用できます。ログインだけでは利用権は付与されず、SciDraftの利用権とは別です。

会員サーバーは認証、製品別の利用権確認、保存済み執筆手順の配信を行い、その手順を受けたChatGPT／Codexが作成を支援します。研究資料・原稿・会話本文をMCPツールの入力として受け取りません。資料はChatGPT／Codexの会話に添付してください。申請システムへのログイン、実提出、決済は行いません。

利用期限は年度版ごとに定められ、購入日から1年間とは限りません。期限終了・利用停止後は完全版手順を新しく取得できません。既に取得した内容や過去のチャットを削除するものではありません。
payload.longDescription:
本服务面向会员，按照公募指南和申请书模板整理研究经费申请构想，分项目创建申请书草案。通过确认制度条件、评审要点、字数与格式限制，逐步推进申请项目整理、研究构想具体化、分项撰写、预算与团队整理、整体审查及提交前确认。不会补充公募资料中未提及的截止日期、预算上限、申请资格或未实施的研究成果推测。

只需选择插件并上传公募指南和申请书模板即可开始。若仅提供单份资料，将单独确认缺失内容，并在每个项目和流程节点等待用户确认。生成的文章、参考文献、数据及公募条件需由用户确认，本服务不保证通过审核。

完整版撰写支持需连接已注册SciGrant有效使用权的会员账户。已有购买权限的用户可通过提供的付费Note内的注册链接登记产品使用权，添加ChatGPT/Codex插件后，使用与注册时相同的登录方式和会员账户连接。会员账户可独立于Note或ChatGPT的注册账户。仅登录不会授予使用权，且与SciDraft使用权分开。

会员服务器负责认证、验证产品使用权、分发已保存的撰写流程，接收流程的ChatGPT/Codex将提供创作支持。不接收研究资料、原稿或对话文本作为MCP工具输入，资料需作为附件添加至ChatGPT/Codex对话。不处理申请系统登录、实际提交或支付操作。

使用期限按年度版本设定，不必然自购买日起计算1年。期限届满或使用权中止后，无法重新获取完整版流程。不会删除已获取内容或历史聊天记录。

payload.name: Tabulous
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your AI assistant to a Tabulous workspace. It can look up Registry tables and records, list files on a record, and inspect toolkit scripts and apps, so you can ask questions about samples, experiments, and other lab data without leaving the chat.

When something needs to change, the assistant stages a complete plan as a changeset and gives you a review link. Invalid plans are rejected up front. Nothing is written to live data until you approve it.
payload.longDescription:
将 AI 助手连接到 Tabulous 工作区。它可以查询 Registry 表和记录、列出记录中的文件，并检查工具包脚本和应用，让你无需离开聊天就能询问样本、实验和其他实验室数据。

需要更改内容时，助手会将完整计划整理成变更集，并提供审核链接。无效计划会预先拒绝。在你批准之前，不会将任何内容写入线上数据。

payload.name: Selenium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your B12 account to research chemical synthesis strategies, assess routes, and develop a selected strategy into a detailed route. Compare literature evidence, starting materials, reaction steps, and uncertainties. Revisit saved assessments and planning results across conversations. Research and route-development availability depends on your account configuration. Proposed routes require expert review and experimental validation.
payload.longDescription: 连接您的B12账户以研究化学合成策略，评估路线，并将选定策略转化为详细路线。比较文献证据、起始材料、反应步骤和不确定性。在对话中回顾已保存的评估和规划结果。研究及路线开发功能的可用性取决于您的账户配置。建议的路线需要经过专家评审和实验验证。

payload.name: Biohub ESM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Biohub ESM helps you understand proteins from a name, sequence, or file: explore mutation landscapes, interpret what ESMC sees, predict and view all-atom structures, and discover related proteins. It chooses the right ESM workflow, preserves confidence and provenance, and presents results automatically. It also supports MSA-guided and modified-complex workflows, and private or large-scale compute routing. Supported protein sequences use the Biohub MCP viewer. Complexes and exact prediction files use a separate molecular viewer when available, with an agent-generated static rendering as a last resort where local rendering tools are available. Managed inference requires a Biohub API key and may incur usage charges. Predictions support research hypotheses, not experimental conclusions.
payload.longDescription: Biohub ESM可通过蛋白质名称、序列或文件帮助您深入理解：探索突变图谱，解析ESMC看到的内容，预测并查看全原子结构，发现相关蛋白质。它会自动选择合适的ESM工作流，保留置信度和来源信息，并呈现结果。该工具支持多序列比对引导和修改后的复杂工作流，以及私有化或大规模计算资源调度。受支持的蛋白质序列使用Biohub MCP查看器，复合物和精确预测文件在可用时会使用独立分子查看器，当地渲染工具可用时则以代理生成的静态渲染作为最后手段。管理推理需要Biohub API密钥，可能产生使用费用。预测结果支持研究假设，而非实验结论。

payload.name: Prognyx oncology intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Live ClinicalTrials.gov oncology trial comparison around an asset, plus landscapes and CI briefings.

Free, read-only MCP server from Prognyx (oncology competitive intelligence). Three tools: compare_trials returns up to three interventional ClinicalTrials.gov studies around an asset or target in one oncology indication, side by side (sponsor, phase, status, declared arms, primary outcomes, last update, registry URL); search_registry gives the live landscape of a target, company, indication or NCT number (study counts, leading sponsors, phase mix, recent studies, related briefings); search_briefings searches Prognyx briefings, where each claim links to a primary source. No account, no API key. Registry records describe declared designs; a match does not establish that two programmes compete.
payload.longDescription:
围绕特定资产的实时临床试验.gov肿瘤学试验对比，以及全景图和CI简报。

Prognyx提供的免费只读MCP服务器（肿瘤学竞争情报）。
三个工具：compare_trials可在一种肿瘤学适应症中，围绕特定资产或靶点同时比较最多三项干预性临床试验.gov研究（赞助方、阶段、状态、声明的分组、主要结果、最后更新、注册URL）；search_registry可获取靶点、公司、适应症或NCT编号的实时全景图（研究数量、领先赞助方、阶段分布、近期研究、相关简报）；search_briefings可搜索Prognyx简报，每个声明均链接至原始来源。
无需账户，无需API密钥。
注册记录描述声明的设计；匹配并不表示两个项目存在竞争关系。

payload.name: Cypris Q
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cypris Q brings specialized R&D and innovation intelligence to your team in ChatGPT through a secure connection to your Cypris account.

Unlock access to Cypris's global intelligence layer across patents, scientific literature, chemical compounds, companies, and technical markets. Your team can use Cypris Q inside ChatGPT to investigate prior art, freedom to operate, competitive landscapes, technology trends, whitespace opportunities, and other critical questions across the R&D and IP stage-gate process.

Ask a research question and Cypris goes to work, returning a cited report in the conversation a few minutes later.

Cypris is purpose-built for high-stakes technical and strategic research. Responses are grounded in authoritative source material, with citations that allow users to review the evidence behind each finding.

Cypris Q is designed for R&D, IP, innovation, strategy, and technical teams that want to make ChatGPT more valuable by extending it with specialized datasets, research workflows, and domain-specific intelligence.
payload.longDescription:
通过与Cypris账户的安全连接，Cypris Q将专业的研发和创新情报带入您的团队，在ChatGPT中实现高效协作。

解锁Cypris全球情报层，覆盖专利、科学文献、化学物质、企业及技术市场领域。
您的团队可在ChatGPT内使用Cypris Q开展专利检索、自由实施分析、竞争格局研究、技术趋势洞察、市场空白机会挖掘等关键课题，贯穿研发与知识产权阶段门禁流程。

提出研究问题后，Cypris将开始工作，几分钟内返回带有引用的报告。

Cypris专为高风险的技术与战略研究场景设计。
所有回复均基于权威资料，通过引用体系让用户可追溯每个结论的证据来源。

Cypris Q专为研发、知识产权、创新、战略和技术团队设计，旨在通过扩展专用数据集、研究工作流程和领域特定智能，提升ChatGPT的实用价值。

payload.name: SciDraft (2026)
payload.description: 研究資料から科学論文ドラフトを段落ごとに作成
payload.summaryOriginal: 研究資料から科学論文ドラフトを段落ごとに作成
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
自然科学・医学の研究テーマ、研究計画書、進捗資料をもとに、科学論文の構成とドラフトを対話形式で作成する会員向けの執筆支援です。研究が計画段階か実施済みかを区別し、未取得の結果や不足情報を埋めずに確認します。Introductionから各セクションへ進み、原稿は段落ごとに利用者の確認を待ちながら作成・推敲します。

プラグインを選択して研究資料を添付するだけでも開始できます。作成言語が未指定の場合だけ日本語・英語を確認し、指定済みの言語を尊重します。既存原稿の改稿や、研究計画から論文化に必要な情報を整理する場面にも対応します。生成された文章、引用文献、数値、研究上の主張は利用者による確認が必要です。診断や治療を行うサービスではありません。

執筆支援の利用には、SciDraftの有効な利用権を持つ会員アカウントへの接続が必要です。ChatGPT／Codexでプラグインを追加した後、利用登録時と同じログイン方法・同じ会員アカウントで接続してください。会員アカウントはChatGPTの登録アカウントと異なっていても利用できます。ログインだけでは利用権は付与されず、SciGrantの利用権とは別です。

会員サーバーは認証、製品別の利用権確認、保存済み執筆手順の配信を行い、その手順を受けたChatGPT／Codexが執筆を支援します。研究資料・原稿・会話本文をMCPツールの入力として受け取りません。資料はChatGPT／Codexの会話に添付してください。論文の実投稿や決済は行いません。

有効な利用権を確認できない場合は、執筆手順を取得できません。既に取得した内容や過去のチャットを削除する機能はありません。

payload.name: Arca FDA, Trials & PubMed
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Arca Life Sciences searches a curated index of public regulatory, clinical, and scientific records and returns results with links to the original source.

What you can search:
- FDA drug records: labels, Drugs@FDA approvals and review documents, complete response letters, warning letters, Form 483s, inspections, import refusals, Orange Book, Purple Book, NDC, drug shortages, and postmarket requirements
- FDA device records: 510(k), PMA, registrations, GUDID, and MAUDE adverse event reports
